title: GitHub & GitLab Notifier
description:
A self-hosted Telegram bot written in Go for monitoring GitHub and GitLab repositories.

The bot receives webhook events and sends notifications to a Telegram forum (Topics).
A separate topic is automatically created for each event type.

Supported events:
— GitHub: Push, Star (in progress: PR, Issues, Fork, Release)
— GitLab: Push, Merge Request, Issue, Pipeline (in progress)

Features:
— A single webhook endpoint automatically detects the platform
— SQLite for state storage (pure Go)
— Proxy support for restricted networks
— Multi-language support (EN / RU)
